args.title: Historical Honeycomb Alert Handling — Dec 23, 2023–Jan 1, 2024
args.body:
# Historical Honeycomb Alert Handling

**Coverage period:** December 23, 2023 through January 1, 2024  
**Normal schedule resumed:** Tuesday, January 2, 2024

## Operating guidance

- **Thresholds:** Keep the existing Honeycomb alert thresholds unchanged throughout the holiday coverage period.
- **Paging:** Page the named on-call owner first, following the holiday roster. Engineering/production coverage was Marcus primary, with Leo Park as backup. Customer support triage was Rishi primary, with Priya as backup. Product/design clarification for active customer issues was Priya primary, with Jake as backup. Devon Haye held deploy and rollback authority.
- **Escalation:** Escalate only when there is confirmed customer impact or when the named owner is unreachable after the documented escalation path. Founders were not intended to be a catch-all escalation route.
- **Quiet-week reporting:** Do not escalate ordinary alert noise or non-urgent cleanup during the reduced schedule. Roll quiet alerts and other non-actionable activity into the Monday digest.

## Historical outcome

The reduced-week digest reported two non-production alert flaps, no confirmed customer impact, and one slow acknowledgment. The handling direction remained unchanged: preserve current thresholds, page the named owner first, escalate only under the defined conditions, and defer non-urgent cleanup until January.
